name: ZoomInfo
summary: Enterprise B2B sales intelligence and contact database. Find verified company and contact data, buying signals and org charts to fuel outbound at scale.
best_for: enterprise go-to-market teams that need the deepest US database, buyer-intent signals and conversation intelligence — and can absorb the contract
skip_if: you're an SMB or want flexible month-to-month pricing — the cost, credit burn and lock-in rarely pay off below enterprise scale
honest_knock: The contract is the most-cited frustration: annual lock-in with a strict 60–90 day cancellation window and 10–20% renewal increases. Credits burn fast, data can be stale (prospects who left years ago), and it's built for enterprise — overkill and overpriced for SMBs, with weaker accuracy outside the US.

pricing.notes: Sales-gated, and re-verified as such on 2026-08-17: no public rates, no monthly billing and no free plan, with the pricing URL refusing plain requests and neither of our monthly captures retrieving a figure. Contracts typically start around $15k and the median runs near $32k a year, climbing once seats, credits and add-ons (intent data, international coverage) stack up — but those are third-party figures, not ZoomInfo's, and every deal is negotiated annually. Expect a multi-year push and price the credits, not just the seats.

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
